review:
A lighter, faster-loading version of Wazdan's Power of Gods: Medusa, made with mobile in mind. The gameplay is built around Sticky Bonus symbols that stay on the reels for up to 9 respins, raising your chance of triggering Hold the Jackpot.

That bonus can pay up to 2,500x your bet. High volatility, 96.18% RTP. The "Extremely Light" label is about the tech, not the maths: Wazdan made it smoother and less demanding on your phone. A good one if the full-size Wazdan games feel slow on your device, and the sticky symbols give the base game a bit of build-up between bonuses.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
